additional_info.subject: Service Request – Shell Recharge Station Maintenance - Station T2 R4 – 313020197001
additional_info.body:
Good morning,
During a visit to the
Shell Recharge | Posto Rosim – Rod. Anhanguera, 207, Vila Belmiro, Pirassununga – SP, 13633-480
, I noticed that the right side of the HMI screen is darkening. I believe that over time this black spot will expand, eventually making it difficult to view the station’s display information.
Therefore, I would like to request the opening of a maintenance ticket under warranty for
Station T2 R4 – 313020197001
, so that this issue can be analyzed and repaired.
For further support in the assessment, I have attached a video showing the charger’s screen.
I look forward to your feedback.
Best regards,
